ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 32
   C. 9
   D. 64

2. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 15
   D. 30

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

10. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

3. A — 12x + 2

4. A — 31.6

5. D — 30
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Perimeter = 2(L + W)
2. Substitute values: P = 2(11 + 4)
3. P = 2(15)
4. P = 30
Final Answer: 30 cm
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

6. C — 1

7. D — 2/2

8. A — 1

9. A — 15.6

10. A — x > 5

11. B — 23.6

12. A — 1
